title: VIN Decoder (NHTSA vPIC, Batch)
description: Decode up to thousands of VINs with NHTSA's official vPIC database: make, model, year, trim, body class, engine, displacement, fuel type, drive type, plant, GVWR, safety equipment and error codes. 50 VINs per request.
useCases: Dealers, auctions and insurers enriching VIN lists
AI agents answering 'what car is this VIN'
